# ---- corrected tracker: snapshot AFTER each transition + explicit decision ----
def new_cluster(node_id, members):
    return ReplicaState(node_id=node_id, members=members)


rows = []


def cap(state, action, detail="", committed_to=None):
    rows.append({
        "action": action, "detail": detail,
        "epoch": state.epoch, "role": state.role, "leader": state.leader_id or "-",
        "quorum": state.quorum_size, "log": state.last_log_index,
        "commit": state.commit_index, "applied": state.applied_index,
        "commit_delta": committed_to,
    })


def tx(rid, op, key, val=None):
    return Transaction("alice", rid, op, key,
                       None if val is None else str(val).encode(), time.time_ns(), {})


# 5-member cluster -> quorum = 3, so 2/3-equivalent acks are genuinely short
M5 = ("n1", "n2", "n3", "n4", "n5")
st = new_cluster("n1", M5)
ev, stepc = [], [0]
start_election(st, "n1", ev, stepc)
cap(st, "elect n1", f"epoch={st.epoch}, quorum={st.quorum_size}")

# append #1: leader-only (1/5) -> must NOT commit
append_entry(st, tx("r1", "put", "k1", 1))
b = st.commit_index; advance_commit(st); apply_committed(st)
cap(st, "append+advance #1", f"1/5 acked < quorum {st.quorum_size}", st.commit_index - b)

# replicate to n2 only (2/5) -> still short of quorum 3
replicate(st, "n2", 1, ev, stepc)
b = st.commit_index; advance_commit(st); apply_committed(st)
cap(st, "advance #1 @2/5", "2/5 acked < quorum 3", st.commit_index - b)

# replicate to n3 (3/5) -> NOW commits
replicate(st, "n3", 1, ev, stepc)
b = st.commit_index; advance_commit(st); apply_committed(st)
cap(st, "advance #1 @3/5", "3/5 acked >= quorum 3", st.commit_index - b)

df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
print("=== corrected timeline (post-op snapshots, explicit commit decision) ===")
print(df.to_string(index=False))

# ---- quorum arithmetic for common cluster sizes ----------------------------
qdf = pd.DataFrame([{
    "members": n, "quorum = floor(n/2)+1": n // 2 + 1,
    "tolerated failures": n - (n // 2 + 1),
    "leader + acks needed": (n // 2 + 1) - 1,
} for n in (1, 3, 5, 7, 9)])
print("\n=== quorum arithmetic ===")
print(qdf.to_string(index=False))
